    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    D = instance["distance_matrix"]

        for x in route:

        return s

        c += D[route[-1]][depot]

        if pos == 0:

            b = route[0]
            return D[a][node] + D[node][b] - D[a][b]
        if pos == len(route):

            b = depot

        b = route[pos]
        return D[a][node] + D[node][b] - D[a][b]

                best_pos = pos

        return c

    def insert_delta(route, pos, node):
        if not route:
            return 2 * D[depot][node]
        if pos == 0:
            a = depot
            b = route[0]
            return D[a][node] + D[node][b] - D[a][b]
        if pos == len(route):
            a = route[-1]
            b = depot
            return D[a][node] + D[node][b] - D[a][b]
        a = route[pos - 1]
        b = route[pos]
        return D[a][node] + D[node][b] - D[a][b]

    def best_insertion(route, node):
        best_pos = 0
        best_delta = insert_delta(route, 0, node)
        for pos in range(1, len(route) + 1):
            delta = insert_delta(route, pos, node)
            if delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and pos < best_pos):
                best_delta = delta
                best_pos = pos
        return best_pos, best_delta

    def reverse_segment(route, i, k):
        return route[:i] + route[i:k + 1][::-1] + route[k + 1:]

    customers.sort(key=lambda x: (-demands[x], -D[depot][x], x))

    routes = []
    loads = []

    # Constructive insertion
    for node in customers:
        best = None
        for r_idx, route in enumerate(routes):
            if loads[r_idx] + demands[node] > capacity:
                continue
            pos, delta = best_insertion(route, node)
            key = (delta, len(route), r_idx, pos)
            if best is None or key < best[0]:
                best = (key, r_idx, pos)
        if best is None:
            routes.append([node])
            loads.append(demands[node])
        else:
            _, r_idx, pos = best
            routes[r_idx].insert(pos, node)
            loads[r_idx] += demands[node]

    # Savings-based route merging
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
        best = None
        best_gain = 0
        for i in range(len(routes)):
            ri = routes[i]
            li = loads[i]
            if not ri:
                continue
            for j in range(i + 1, len(routes)):
                rj = routes[j]
                lj = loads[j]
                if li + lj > capacity:
                    continue
                if not rj:
                    continue
                a0, a1 = ri[0], ri[-1]
                b0, b1 = rj[0], rj[-1]
                variants = [
                    (ri + rj, D[depot][a1] + D[depot][b0] - D[a1][b0]),
                    (ri + rj[::-1], D[depot][a1] + D[depot][b1] - D[a1][b1]),
                    (ri[::-1] + rj, D[depot][a0] + D[depot][b0] - D[a0][b0]),
                    (ri[::-1] + rj[::-1], D[depot][a0] + D[depot][b1] - D[a0][b1]),
                ]
                for merged, gain in variants:
                    if gain > best_gain or (gain == best_gain and best is not None and (i, j, len(merged)) < best[0]):
                        best_gain = gain
                        best = ((i, j, len(merged)), i, j, merged)
        if best is not None and best_gain > 0:
            _, i, j, merged = best
            routes[i] = merged
            routes.pop(j)
            improved = True

    # Inter-route relocate and swap
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]

        best_move = None
        best_delta = 0
        for a in range(len(routes)):
            ra = routes[a]
            la = loads[a]
            for idx, node in enumerate(ra):
                prev = depot if idx == 0 else ra[idx - 1]
                nxt = depot if idx == len(ra) - 1 else ra[idx + 1]
                remove_delta = D[prev][nxt] - D[prev][node] - D[node][nxt]
                for b in range(len(routes)):
                    if a == b:
                        continue
                    if loads[b] + demands[node] > capacity:
                        continue
                    rb = routes[b]
                    pos, ins_delta = best_insertion(rb, node)
                    delta = remove_delta + ins_delta
                    if delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and best_move is not None and (a, b, idx, pos) < best_move[:4]):
                        best_delta = delta
                        best_move = (a, b, idx, pos, node)
        if best_move is not None and best_delta < 0:
            a, b, idx, pos, node = best_move
            if a < b:
                routes[a].pop(idx)
                routes[b - 1].insert(pos, node)
                if not routes[a]:
                    routes.pop(a)
            else:
                routes[a].pop(idx)
                routes[b].insert(pos, node)
                if not routes[a]:
                    routes.pop(a)
            changed = True
            continue

        best_swap = None
        best_delta = 0
        for a in range(len(routes)):
            ra = routes[a]
            for ia, na in enumerate(ra):
                pa = depot if ia == 0 else ra[ia - 1]
                naxt = depot if ia == len(ra) - 1 else ra[ia + 1]
                rem_a = D[pa][naxt] - D[pa][na] - D[na][naxt]
                for b in range(a + 1, len(routes)):
                    rb = routes[b]
                    for ib, nb in enumerate(rb):
                        pb = depot if ib == 0 else rb[ib - 1]
                        nbxt = depot if ib == len(rb) - 1 else rb[ib + 1]
                        rem_b = D[pb][nbxt] - D[pb][nb] - D[nb][nbxt]
                        la = loads[a] - demands[na] + demands[nb]
                        lb = loads[b] - demands[nb] + demands[na]
                        if la > capacity or lb > capacity:
                            continue
                        add_a = D[pa][nb] + D[nb][naxt] - D[pa][naxt]
                        add_b = D[pb][na] + D[na][nbxt] - D[pb][nbxt]
                        delta = rem_a + rem_b + add_a + add_b
                        if delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and best_swap is not None and (a, b, ia, ib) < best_swap[:4]):
                            best_delta = delta
                            best_swap = (a, b, ia, ib, na, nb)
        if best_swap is not None and best_delta < 0:
            a, b, ia, ib, na, nb = best_swap
            routes[a][ia] = nb
            routes[b][ib] = na
            changed = True

    # Intra-route 2-opt
    for r_idx in range(len(routes)):
        route = routes[r_idx]
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            n = len(route)
            if n < 4:
                break
            best_gain = 0
            best_pair = None
            for i in range(n - 2):
                a = depot if i == 0 else route[i - 1]
                b = route[i]
                for k in range(i + 2, n):
                    c = route[k]
                    d = depot if k == n - 1 else route[k + 1]
                    gain = D[a][b] + D[c][d] - D[a][c] - D[b][d]
                    if gain > best_gain or (gain == best_gain and best_pair is not None and (i, k) < best_pair):
                        best_gain = gain
                        best_pair = (i, k)
            if best_pair is not None and best_gain > 0:
                i, k = best_pair
                route = reverse_segment(route, i, k)
                routes[r_idx] = route
                improved = True

    # Final cleanup: remove empties if any
    routes = [r for r in routes if r]
    return routes
